title: 13章 黎明时分黑暗隐14章 难以割舍的血脉
lines: 月亮不知什么时候，悄悄地躲了起来，四周也变得更加的幽暗，黎明前的夜，总是黑的让人难受。
一直到了黎明时分，张荼才渐渐地停歇了下来，简单介绍了一下边关月，说是自己的多年好友，恰巧因故滞留在了这里，路上偶遇，就一起带了回来。
面对这个拙劣的谎言，张父张母欣然接受。
烟火渐熄，张荼叼上了最后一根烟，小声招呼着父母，向着远处的黑暗中走去。
他知道父母的忧虑，他又何尝不担忧远在老宅的老人呢。
可若是按照突变之后的规则，原本不过几十里的路程，如今怕是要接近几百里路程，而且地形大变之后，路上会遇到什么，他真的摸不准。
不过看了看身旁的边关月，且附近能救援的都已经救援了，再远，也就爱莫能助了，自己也不是了无牵挂了，所以张图觉得，尝试一下也没有什么问题。
一行四人摸黑上路，所幸这不过是黎明之前的最后黑暗，不多时，天空便是泛起了鱼肚白，看着断断续续出现的熟悉地标，路，应该是没有走错。
每一个夜晚都是一次死亡，每一个黎明都是一次重生，原本每天都欢喜地面对人事物，而今睁目之后，却是对于生命的不知所措。
一路无言，一路狼藉，一路荒芜。
急促的刹车声惊醒了沉睡的张父张母。
“荼荼，怎么了？”张母傅缃叶紧张地问道。
张父张顺圣眯着眼打量着车窗外的情景，不言不语。
边关月嘴角划起讥讽的弧度，说道：“阿姨莫慌，应该是有人劫道……怀念啊，多久没有碰到劫道的了，这个职业，可真是长久，一道乱世，就会出现，比野草的生命力都顽强。”
“呼。”张荼满不在乎地解开安全带，说道：“好啦，别感慨了，到了主人家，还是去看看的好，你觉得呢？不过看你这么有兴趣，你处理好了。”
旋即转头对着张父张母说道：“爸妈，你们就别下来了，在车上呆着，最多啊，就是一些小痞子趁乱讨点钱财，不碍事的。”
傅缃叶紧张地说道：“不行我们就给他们点，反正我们也是带了一些……”
张母的话还没说完，就被张父打断道：“女人见识，这时候，不想着安分守己，救助村邻反而还有心思出来拦路的，会有那么小的胃口么？哼，别忘了，如今的荼荼可不是以前了，相信他。”
张荼和边关月相视一笑，同时开门下车。
看着不远处横七竖八的木头栅栏，明显的人为迹象，这段路并非是唯一的路，不过这一段却是还维持着昔日的公路，开起来比较舒服，可也正是如此，有人便利用此地来做了些文章。
果不其然，随着张荼和边关月的下车，周围的树木背后，也稀稀疏疏出来十多个身影，高矮胖瘦全都有，哦，还有一个光明顶。
手中拿的东西更是五花八门，那什么的都用，甚至是拿着一个大号扳手就出来了。
“现在……质量都这么差了么？”边关月厌恶地看着眼前的十几人，尤其是还有几个堪比孕妇的大肚子，满脸的嫌弃。
“哥几个，啥意思啊？”张荼扬声说道。
“嘿嘿嘿，兄弟。”一个大腹便便的男子越众而出，看模样，三十上下，面脸油光，但是眉宇间却是有着几分阴气，将整体的富态破坏得一干二净。
“这突遭大变，家里受穷，看兄弟你开的车也不错，所以想着啊，兄弟能不能帮衬帮衬，救救急。”
张荼闻言，直接笑出了声，说道：“你家通网了吗？这年头谁出门还带现金啊，你不掏出手机看看，这手机有网么？就算我想帮衬帮衬，哥们我也是有心无力啊。”
“兄弟这是不给面子啊，上一对小两口也是这么说，不过嘛却是不诚实，不过那娘儿们却是很润。话说回来，几人不给兄弟面子，那兄弟就只有自己拿了。”胖子嘿嘿笑了两声，挥手说道：“兄弟们，上！”
看着渐渐围上来的小喽啰们，只见一根漆黑的长枪横在了张荼的面前，张荼下意识的握在手中，一声若有似无的嗡鸣声在张荼的耳边响起。
似龙吟，像呼啸，如猛虎出匣，又如龙归大海，向着这片天地，发出不屈的怒吼。
一群喽啰看着边关月不知什么地方突然掏出的长枪，心中惊骇，脚步竟是一时间停滞不前。
“哟，这小魔术变得不错嘛。”胖子出现说道，笑得乐不可支，说道：“要不要再变几个人出来啊。”
“当真如此？”
“必须如此！世道乱，仁慈要分人。”
摩挲着手中长枪，张荼眼睛微微眯起，体内的长春内息向着长枪滚滚而去，刹那间，仅凭手中一柄长枪，竟是绽放出了金戈铁马的惨烈气息，这些，是铭刻在长枪中的记忆，是曾经倒在长枪之下冤魂不散的诅咒。
霎时间，枪芒耀眼，斜刺穿出，向着最近的一人刺去，那人手持一柄巨大的扳手，看着长枪来袭，徒劳无功的试图拦截，可是手中那硕大的扳手，在与长枪触碰之时，犹如云泥之别。
content_en:
I don't know when the moon quietly hid, and the surroundings became darker. The night before dawn was always dark and uncomfortable.
It was not until dawn that Zhang Tu gradually stopped and briefly introduced Bian Guanyue, saying that he was his friend for many years and happened to be stranded here for some reason. They met by chance on the road and brought him back together.
Faced with this clumsy lie, Zhang's father and Zhang's mother readily accepted it.
As the fireworks gradually went out, Zhang Tu took the last cigarette in his mouth, greeted his parents in a low voice, and walked into the darkness in the distance.
He knew his parents were worried, so why didn't he worry about the old man who was far away in his old home.
But if he followed the rules after the mutation, the distance that was originally only a few dozen miles would now be close to hundreds of miles. Moreover, after the terrain changed drastically, he was really not sure what he would encounter on the road.
However, he looked at Bian Guanyue beside him, and everyone who could be rescued nearby had already been rescued. No matter how far away, there was nothing he could do to help, and he was no longer worry-free, so Zhang Tu felt that there was no problem in giving it a try.
A group of four people set out on the road in the dark. Fortunately, this was just the last darkness before dawn. After a while, the sky turned white. Looking at the familiar landmarks that appeared intermittently, it seemed that they were on the right track.
Every night is a death, every dawn is a rebirth. I used to face people and things happily every day, but now when I open my eyes, I feel at a loss for life.
The road was speechless, the road was messy, and the road was desolate.
"Squeak..."
The sudden sound of brakes woke up Zhang's parents and Zhang's mother from their deep sleep.
"Tutu, what's wrong?" Zhang's mother Fu Xianye asked nervously.
Zhang's father, Zhang Shunsheng, squinted his eyes and looked at the scene outside the car window without saying a word.
The corners of Bian Guanyue's mouth curved up in a sarcastic arc, and she said: "Auntie, don't panic, there must be someone who has robbed the Dao... I miss you, it's been a long time since I met someone who robbed the Dao. This profession is really long-lasting, and in troubled times, it will appear, and it is stronger than the vitality of weeds."
"Huh." Zhang Tu unbuckled his seat belt nonchalantly and said, "Okay, don't be emotional. It's better to go and have a look when you get to the owner's house. What do you think? But seeing that you are so interested, you can take care of it."
He immediately turned to Zhang's father and mother and said, "Mom and dad, please don't get down and stay in the car. At most, they will just be some little gangsters taking advantage of the chaos to ask for some money. They won't get in the way."
Fu Xianye said nervously: "If that doesn't work, we'll give them some. Anyway, we brought some..."
Before Zhang's mother finished speaking, Zhang's father interrupted: "As a woman, at this time, instead of thinking about staying safe and rescuing the village neighbors, she still wants to block the way. How can she have such a small appetite? Hum, don't forget, the Tutu today is not the same as before, believe him."
Zhang Tu and Bian Guanyue looked at each other and smiled, opening the door and getting out of the car at the same time.
Looking at the scattered wooden fences not far away, there are obvious signs of man-made changes. This section of the road is not the only road, but this section still maintains the former highway, which is more comfortable to drive. But because of this, someone took advantage of this place to make some articles.
Sure enough, as Zhang Tu and Bian Guanyue got out of the car, more than a dozen figures appeared from behind the surrounding trees, tall, short, fat and thin, and oh, there was also a bright dome.
There are all kinds of things in his hands, and he can use them for everything. He even came out with a large wrench.
"Now... is the quality so bad?" Bian Guanyue looked at the dozen or so people in front of her with disgust, especially the ones with big bellies comparable to those of pregnant women, with a look of disgust on her face.
"Brothers, what do you mean?" Zhang Tu said loudly.
"Hey, hey, brother." A man with a big belly stood out from the crowd. He looked about thirty, with a shiny face, but there was a bit of yin between his brows, completely destroying the overall wealth.
"This is a big change. My family is in poverty. I see that you drive a good car, brother, so I was wondering if you could help me out."
Zhang Tu laughed out loud when he heard this and said, "Is your home connected to the Internet? Who carries cash when going out these days? Why don't you take out your mobile phone and see if it has Internet access? Even if I want to help, brother, I am powerless."
"Brother, this is not giving face to the brother. The last couple said the same thing, but it was dishonest, but the woman is very smooth. Having said that, if a few people don't give the brother face, the brother will have to take it for himself." The fat man laughed twice, waved and said: "Brothers, come on!"
Looking at the minions gradually surrounding him, he saw a dark spear lying in front of Zhang Tu. Zhang Tu subconsciously held it in his hand, and a vague buzzing sound sounded in Zhang Tu's ears.
Like a dragon roaring, like a roar, like a tiger coming out of its box, and like a dragon returning to the sea, roaring unyieldingly towards the world.
A group of minions looked at the spear that Bian Guanyue suddenly pulled out from nowhere. They were horrified and their footsteps stopped for a moment.
"Hey, this little magic turned out pretty good." The fat man appeared and said, smiling happily, and said, "Would you like to transform into a few more people?"
"Really?"
"It must be like this! The world is in chaos, and kindness must be divided among people."
Touching the spear in his hand, Zhang Tu narrowed his eyes slightly, and the eternal spring breath in his body rolled towards the spear. In an instant, the spear in his hand actually released the tragic aura of a golden horse. These are the memories engraved in the spear, and the curse of those who once fell under the spear.
In an instant, the spear's light was dazzling, and it pierced out diagonally, stabbing towards the nearest person. The man was holding a huge wrench, watching the spear coming, trying in vain to intercept it, but the huge wrench in his hand was like clouds and mud when it came into contact with the spear.
